question: Is the apparent gamma=0 versus gamma=1 refit difference larger than ordinary one-start geometry-basin variation?

locked_formula.geometry_family: same six P0601 pseudo-elliptical and shear parameters

robustness.primary_comparison: best complete training fit for each gamma
robustness.distribution_comparison: median and 16-84 percentile training and spent-heldout RMS across complete one-start fits

claim_limits: This audit is post hoc after observing P0608 optimizer-basin divergence.
RX J2129 and every image split remain spent.
A stable gamma difference would still be phenomenological and would require transfer to a different cluster.
